title: toxicodendrum cobbe
intro: Toxicodendrum cobbe, commonly known as the lacquer tree or blistering nut, is a plant species within the family Anacardiaceae. It is known for its resin, which contains urushiol, a potent allergenic compound that can cause severe skin irritation and allergic reactions in some individuals. Despite its toxic properties, the plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its reported health benefits. The bioactive constituents of the plant, including urushiol and other lignans, exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
